about: The physics trial of the crew habitat (F11, experimental): a tool case dropped onto the mess table and a storage case onto the floor, the north hatch's leaf opened by its hinge's motor (a powered hatch), a stool pushed across the floor. The habitat is on the Moon. Its models carry no labelled parts, so every one takes `material`. Points are in the stage's frame (metres, y up); `at` is a drop's [x, z]; a push is a kinematic box (an unseen hand) moved in a straight line between its seconds. The stool's hand meets its base and foot ring (2 to 22 cm up): set on its column (20 to 40 cm) it knocked the stool over, and on its side the stool's round hull rolled on to the trial's end (2026-10-15).
